sense: to have clothes on your body

pins.definition: (reflexive, ponerse) To dress yourself in an item of clothing.
To have clothing, shoes, or accessories on your body.
To have clothes, shoes, glasses, or accessories on one's body, or to keep a hairstyle or beard.
